notes: Corrected typescript, manuscript running head “- IV- 1102 -”. The 1102 is handwritten; IV and the hyphens are typed. Our scan is 19; H calls it page 18; the pencilled archival sheet number is 18 at the bottom left.
No date, salutation, letterhead, signature or mathematical diagram is visible. The long marginal bracket is an actual graphic annotation and is reproduced in TikZ.

Section (21.6.5) associates a closed subscheme Y(D) to a positive divisor and describes the local regular equation. Its converse identifies a regular codimension-one closed immersion with such a divisor. A raised noetherian hypothesis belongs after the first “sur X”.

The slanted editorial note asks for the converse passage to “devrait [figurer|passer] dans 21.2. (sans hyp. noeth.)”. Several reduced handwritten words remain doubtful. The actual bracket begins beside “est un sous-préschéma”, below the preceding “On notera…” line.
The separate underlined “réf !” requests a reference beside the paragraph about maximal points, codimension and artinian local rings. It is above the proposition, not physically beside its statement.

The page defines cyc(D) by local lengths in (21.6.5.1) and states Proposition (21.6.6), asserting additivity on positive divisors. The proof reduces to the local length identity and multiplication by a regular element.
There is a visible detached prime-like stroke after the first D and another by the sum. Neither was removed because the mathematics would be simpler without it.
The singleton in the codimension expression is unbarred; the singleton in the cycle display has a full explicit overbar. H’s overbar in the codimension expression is unsupported by the crop.
The comma after the deleted noetherian clause is outside the visible cancellation endpoints. I have left it live, as a source remnant, rather than silently regularizing the resulting punctuation.

The heavily blackened phrase beside réf! does not allow me to establish C’s suggested partie. The reading records approximately four unread cancelled words. Other candidate deleted words are expressly tentative.
A repeated equality and a repeated plus stand on either side of two physical line turns. Both are preserved in the diplomatic text.
The final sentence is unfinished on this sheet and ends “on”; no continuation has been supplied.

math_checks.claim: Multiplication by regular t gives A/t’A ≅ tA/tt’A.
math_checks.check: Define a mod t’A ↦ ta mod tt’A. It is surjective by the definition of tA. If ta=tt’b, then t(a-t’b)=0, and regularity of t gives a=t’b. Hence the kernel is zero.
math_checks.result: The local module isomorphism used in the proof is valid under the stated regularity assumption.

math_checks.check: Use 0 → tA/tt’A → A/tt’A → A/tA → 0 and the preceding isomorphism. For finite-length modules, length of the middle module is the sum of the two outer lengths. At a noetherian one-dimensional local ring and a nonunit non-zero-divisor, the quotient has dimension zero; its noetherian local ring is artinian, so its length is finite. A unit gives the zero quotient.
math_checks.result: The algebraic length calculation was checked. The doubled plus signs are preserved as line-turn source marks, not interpreted as a new algebraic operation.

math_checks.claim: The first D may be primed although the ideal and subscheme use D.
math_checks.check: Compared the first positive-divisor character against the D in I_X(D) and Y(D) on the same page. The first has a faint detached high trace; the latter two do not.
math_checks.result: No mathematical normalization was applied; both D-prime and bare-D possibilities remain marked.

math_checks.claim: Global correspondence between positive divisors and regular codimension-one immersions; global monoid homomorphism.
math_checks.check: Read and followed the page’s reduction, but did not supply a separate global gluing proof or re-prove the cited numbered propositions.
math_checks.result: These statements are reported as the page’s claims, not as independently verified theorems.

workflow_feedback.followed: Whole image viewed once; each supplied half viewed once; 13 manually selected crops made with out/scripts/crop.py and each viewed once. No OCR, automatic recognition, external research, other page content or other readers’ files were used.
workflow_feedback.crop_coordinates: Every reported bbox uses the 1681×2165 whole-image coordinate system. The b half begins at whole-image y=1002.
workflow_feedback.crop_rotation: Only r05_margin_note was rotated, by -30 degrees; its bbox remains in the original whole-image coordinates.

workflow_feedback.useful_refinements: Keep a separate inventory entry for each short cancellation, since H sometimes collapses a long deletion and the next line’s short group. Alphabet differences and underline scope need checking even at agreement loci.
